text:
Sam G: Heads-up — Finance noticed a ~40% mismatch between committed GPU credits and our attribution report for Feb. They want a breakdown by product/team before EOD. :grimacing:
Neha P: Wow. Any quick pointers where the delta is? region? sku?
Charlie (eng-infra): Most likely culprit is the new autoscaler changes from last month. Nodepools spin up preemptible gpus without inheriting the workload label in a few edge cases. That means the cost gets allocated to the default project instead of the originating team.
Sam G: Do we have an example invoice/line item? Finance Bot: Pulling invoice lines now. Attached: lines 2024-02-14..2024-02-28, filtered by GPU SKUs. (bot): found 3 clusters with anomalous label-less instances.
Neha P: If it's label inheritance that's rough — some workloads spawn helper pods via a controller that uses a different serviceAccount, so the k8s label propagation didn't occur.
Charlie (eng-infra): I pulled the audit log for one of the suspicious instances. Snippet: `controllers/autoscaler: launched instance "gpu-preempt-xx" project=infra-default labels=[] origin_job=training-replay`
Sam G: That origin_job should've added team:search and product:embed. So the instance got billed to infra-default's commitment bucket. :facepalm:
Neha P: Can we surface that as a metric in the console quickly? Even a per-job tag-failure count so finance can see trend.
Charlie (eng-infra): Yes — I'll add a simple aggregator on the cluster-autoscaler events and emit a short metric `label_inheritance_failures{team,region}`. Should be easy.
Sam G: How bad is the dollar impact? Finance Bot: Preliminary calc: ~$72k of committed GPU-equivalent usage was matched to infra-default instead of the correct chargeback targets across Feb. About 60% of that is within apac clusters.
Neha P: Apac again. Are those nodepools using a different startup script? There was a region-specific rollout for cheaper preemptible SKUs.
Charlie (eng-infra): Yes — apac nodepool uses a trimmed startup image to speed boot; we skipped one init step that patches pod labels for legacy jobs. Looks like a short-lived optimization bit us.
Sam G: OK. Short-term: can we reassign the orphaned line-items to teams by matching instance metadata -> origin_job? Finance Bot: We can file a billing attribution correction with the cloud provider if we can show proof. Need a CSV of instance IDs + intended team tags + timestamps.
Neha P: I can produce a reconciliation mapping from our job history service: job_id -> team/product -> instance_id -> timestamp.
Charlie (eng-infra): I'll produce the audit logs for those instance_ids and a small script to map to label expectations. Paste candidate CSV in thread when ready.
Sam G: Medium-term: don't want another manual rollback. Action list: 1) Charlie to push metric and alert for label_inheritance_failures (P0) 2) Neha to produce reconciliation CSV and hand to Finance (P1) 3) Charlie to patch apac startup to include label patch step and add e2e test (P0) 4) Sam to coordinate billing correction with Finance (P1).
ops-bot: Reminder — Charlie (eng-infra) added a jira: INFRA-1129 "autoscaler: ensure label propagation for preemptible boot path" assigned.
Neha P: Will also flag teams that spawn helper pods (not the main job) — they need to ensure they set owner labels. I'll send a short doc and a compliance check in the next release.
Sam G: Finance asked for an estimate of recovered committed-coverage after we reassign. Can we estimate?
Charlie (eng-infra): If we reassign the 72k to the right teams, reserved coverage delta becomes +28% for those teams (because infra-default was absorbing a lot). But net org-wide commit usage is same; this is purely attribution.
Neha P: Good to know. Finance: do you need anything else to start the provider correction?
Finance Bot: CSV + audit log slices + a short explanation of why labels were missing. Also a point of contact.
Sam G: I'll be the POC. Charlie/Neha — please drop the artifacts here by 11:30 PT.
Charlie (eng-infra): Will do. Uploading audit snippets now.
Neha P: Uploading reconciliation CSV now.
Sam G: Thanks all. Postmortem to include root cause (apac startup optimization), impact (misattribution $72k), fixes (patch + metric + docs), and prevention (CI e2e + billing reconciliation playbook).
Finance Bot: Acknowledged. Creating ticket FIN-547 for provider-side correction.
Charlie (eng-infra): Quick note — while patching we should watch for transient tail latency on node boot; adding a canary to one apac nodepool first.
Sam G: Agreed. Can everyone react with :eyes: when they've reviewed the artifacts?
